settings.ytdlp_help: Send YT-DLP Options. Format: key:value|key:value|key:value. Example: format:bv*+mergeall[vcodec=none]|nocheckcertificate:True Check all yt-dlp api options from this FILE or use this script to convert cli arguments to api options.
settings.name_help:
Send Name Substitute pattern.
Format: old::new|old2::new2
Use \| for literal | in filenames
Use \:: for literal :: in filenames

Examples:
  script::code          # Replace "script" with "code"
  mltb::                # Remove "mltb"
  [test]::test          # Replace "[test]" with "test"
  space::               # Remove spaces
